Proof: adding {1} alone gives a bottom element and every pair then has a meet and a join ({1,2,3} and {1,3,5} meet at {1}; every join is {1,2,3,4,5} or a member), so the finite poset is a complete lattice; {1,3} is not necessary. Stored C was a solved (unofficial) key.
Pre-2014 key changed on proof, without an official key.

fixes.after: Key changed from C to A by proof: S together with {1} is already a complete lattice (finite, has bottom {1} and top {1,2,3,4,5}, all pairwise meets/joins exist), and {1} is necessary because {1,2} and {1,3,5} have no common lower bound in S. Option C adds the unnecessary {1,3}. No official key available.
